about: Composer image intent shared by apps/api/app/modules/images/{gen_intent,lookup_intent}.py and apps/mobile/features/images/model/{imageGenIntent,imageLookupIntent}.ts. Both test suites assert every case, so the phone and the server send the same text to the same place. Change a rule on both sides and update these cases in the same change.
